wiki.summary: “Promise“ is a single released by Icelandic-Chinese songwriter Laufey for her sophomore studio album, Bewitched. She said the following about the track with Genius: “‘Promise’ is a song about that one person you just can’t quite let go of—the person you promise yourself you’ll stop communicating with but always go back to. It’s a piano ballad written in the form of a story that develops with every verse. Starting with a promise to cut ties with a lover and ending with the inevitable return to the lover.“ Read more on Last.fm.
